test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The clerk requested the manager to sanction his leave.

options.text: The clerk informed the manager, “Please sanction my leave”.
The clerk said to the manager, “Do you sanction leave?”
The clerk said to the manager, “Please sanction my leave”.
The clerk said to the manager, “Sanction leave”.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The clerk said to the manager, “Please sanction my leave”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech, where the statement made by the clerk is reported indirectly without using the exact words spoken.
 
• **Structure**: Subject + Reporting Verb + Object + Infinitive Phrase__ (The clerk requested the manager to sanction his leave.)
 __
 
• **Example**: *John asked Mary to pass him the book.*
 
 
 
• In direct speech, the exact words spoken by the speaker are quoted within quotation marks and attributed directly to the speaker.
 
• The reporting verb ("**said**") is used to introduce the quoted speech, and it is followed by the reporting clause ("**to the manager**").
 
• **Structure**: Reporting Clause + Quoted Speech__ (The clerk said to the manager, “Please sanction my leave”.)
 
 
• **Example**: *John said to Mary, "Please pass me the book."*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
